proof:
classical
rcases h_H006.1 with ⟨f, c, hfc⟩
have hs : Submodule.span (R p) (Set.range c) = MR p M := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← hfc]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (f i).property
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro m hm
    have he := congrArg (fun z : M => (z : V)) (f.sum_repr ⟨m, hm⟩)
    simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul] at he
    rw [← he]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i hi
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, (hfc i).symm⟩)
let g := (c.restrictScalars (R p)).map (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hs)
have hg : ∀ i, (g i : V) = c i := by
  intro i
  simp [g]
let E := (f.baseChange (R p)).equiv g (Equiv.refl _)
refine ⟨{ basis := g, tensorEquiv := E, tensor_value := ?_, complex_span := ?_ }⟩
· intro r m
  sorry
· apply top_unique
  rw [← c.span_eq]
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [← hfc]
  exact Submodule.subset_span (f i).property
